title: Rocky Road
method: Line an 18cm square tin with baking paper.
Crush rich tea biscuits into rough chunks.
Gently melt butter, dark chocolate, and golden syrup together in a saucepan.
Fold biscuits, marshmallows, raisins, and cherries into chocolate sauce.
Press firmly into tin and chill in fridge for at least 2 hours before slicing.
